title: PC pairing repaired and live Windows authentication verified
summary: Stopped the two conflicting app-owned helpers, started one Tailscale helper and verified successful desktop protocol authentication. Use the newly generated code in the local CONNECT.txt file.

changes.detail: Removed the duplicate running helper conflict and restarted one helper on the existing Tailscale address. Pairing code rotated; no credentials recorded in history.
Regression tests cover rejected codes and missing session cookies with visible errors and restored button state.
